```plato

    //==
    // # Feature points
    //
    // Cellular (Worley) noise scatters one feature point per lattice cell.
    // Jitter in [0, 1] moves it from the cell centre (0) to anywhere in the cell
    // (1); the two (three) coordinates come from independent mixes of the cell
    // hash.

    // The feature point of planar cell (ix, iy), in cell-local coordinates
    // (the returned offsets are relative to the cell's lower corner).
    FeatureOffset2D(seed: Integer, ix: Integer, iy: Integer, jitter: Number): Vector2D {
        var h = LatticeHash(seed, ix, iy);
        var hx = HashToUnit(h);
        var hy = HashToUnit(NoiseMix(h));
        return (0.5 + (hx - 0.5) * jitter, 0.5 + (hy - 0.5) * jitter);
    }
```
